section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses findings related to pressure to eat messages and their associations with young adults' eating behaviors and body-related variables. The text notes that pressure to eat messages were not significantly associated with intuitive eating or disordered eating in the study sample, though they showed slight relationships with women's perceptions of family pressure to be lean and BMI, with no associations found for men. The section provides theoretical explanations for why childhood pressure to eat may have different effects in young adulthood when individuals have greater autonomy over food choices.
